policy.note: How long a page may go unchecked before it is shown as due for review. Set by how fast the real subject moves, not by how much work the page was. A page with no recorded review is DUE, never fresh -- an unrecorded review is not a review.

why.fast: reset quarterly by the regulator, so a year-old page is simply wrong
why.medium: moves with policy and market structure over a season or two
why.slow: structural; the mechanism does not change from year to year

topics.title: GB electricity wholesale
topics.label: Reviewed 2026-09-10
topics.detail: Checked 0 days ago against a 183-day threshold. Source: Ember, British power prices are increasingly independent from gas; ECIU, Marginal Gains: how wind is pushing gas out of the power market (2025) -- gas marginal in ~85% of hours in 2024, down from close to 90% in 2018, and 2025 hours with gas below 20% of the mix averaging ~£60/MWh against ~£130/MWh where gas exceeded 50%; DESNZ Review of Electricity Market Arrangements Summer Update, 10 July 2025, rejecting zonal pricing and confirming reformed national pricing.

topics.title: Hedging & the forward market
topics.label: Reviewed 2026-09-10
topics.detail: Checked 0 days ago against a 365-day threshold.
